body:
This looks great to me. I made some minor editorial tweaks, but I am quite happy with the event dispatching changes. I know @annevk and @smaug---- are a bit more demanding there, so it'll be good to get their take. And of course web platform tests will help.

But from my perspective, this is ready to merge.

I'd like to apologize for along the way overlooking the fact that we already had `inert` for the `dialog` element so some of the problems here already existed. On the flipside, the `dialog` was element was introduced when we were much less rigorous regarding details and doesn't have a second implementation. I think the main thing I'd like to ask for is to highlight those existing problems using `

...` and maybe also get someone from Safari (hi @hober!) to have a look if this is all they need as they were the other interested implementer. The XXX marker for what a user interaction event (we should probably also preserve that term as-is somewhere) is could maybe point to https://github.com/WICG/event-timing/issues/49. And then we should decide how to deal with the patching of the various selection APIs. Perhaps that's even best separated out as it would affect inert overall?
